'''Drepanopterus''' is an [[extinct]] [[aquatic]] [[vermin]] from the [[wikipedia:Devonian|Devonian]] era, found in [[temperate]] freshwater or brackish [[lake]]s and [[river]]s. They are usable for the [[fishing industry]], but only by [[Fishery|capturing a live fish]], rather than normal fishing, and also [[Kitchen|cookable]] with out cleaning.

Some dwarves [[Preferences|like]] drepanopterus for their ''broad heads''.
